_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: While we were talking, he stood among us.
Peace be with you, he said.
We were startled, thinking we saw a ghost.
But look at my hands; touch me and see.
He took a piece of fish and ate before us.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
He opened our minds to understand. Come, let us worship.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Come and stand close, you who are startled and slow to believe, you who half expect a ghost.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
See his hands, see his feet; this is no spirit but flesh and bone, the friend you watched them kill.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
Watch him take the broiled fish and eat it in front of you, ordinary as any supper.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
Then he opens your mind like a book, and the light of his face falls on you, and you can lie down in peace.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: He stands among us: do not be afraid.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
Touch my hands and feet; it is myself.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
He eats the fish and opens up the Scriptures.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
Come, let us worship in the light of his face.
We are witnesses. Alleluia!
